title: Two Pointers
summary: Walk a sequence from two positions to avoid a nested loop.

content.p: Keep two indices into the same array (or two arrays) and move them according to a rule. It often turns an O(n²) scan into O(n).

ul: Converging: left at the start, right at the end, move inward. Works on sorted data or symmetric problems (palindromes, pair sums, squares of a sorted array).
Fast / slow: both start together, one moves faster. Cycle detection, middle of a linked list.
Read / write: one pointer reads, one writes. In-place filtering and de-duplication.
The input is sorted, or sorting it is acceptable.
You need a pair or triple that satisfies a condition.
You must modify an array in place with O(1) extra space.
